title: EviNote-RAG: Enhancing RAG Models via Answer-Supportive Evidence Notes
authors: Yuqin Dai; Guoqing Wang; Yuan Wang; Kairan Dou; Kaichen Zhou; Zhanwei Zhang; Shuo Yang; Fei Tang; Jun Yin; Pengyu Zeng; Zhenzhe Ying; Can Yi; Changhua Meng; Yuchen Zhou; Yongliang Shen; Shuai Lu
why_relevant: EviNote-RAG explicitly addresses low signal-to-noise ratio in retrieved evidence and error accumulation in multi-hop reasoning by generating supportive-evidence notes with an entailment-based reward, directly relevant to noise robustness in RAG.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on noise filtering via summarization; does not address conflict, adversarial, or calibration aspects.
